title: orthosiphon stamineus
intro: Orthosiphon stamineus, commonly known as Misai Kucing in Malay, is a perennial plant native to the tropical regions of Asia. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, with health benefits including reducing inflammation, relieving urinary tract infections, and lowering blood sugar levels. The therapeutic actions of Orthosiphon stamineus include diuretic, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant effects, which contribute to its use in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and iridoids, such as ursolic acid and oleanolic acid, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
